notes.title: The festival has started now!
notes.content:
The festival has started right now!
STUNSTEVAL SIDEROLLERS is out. The first season is now available. 
But more locations, vehicles, and stories will be available soon.

List of upcoming updates:
- Race editor.
- Multiplayer mode.
- Winter season "Winter Session" with a new "Raid" mode, as well as new transport.
- A themed season about oil cars with new cars.
- The "Neon Nights" season will be dedicated to street racing. With the addition of new Nitro mechanics.

notes.title: End of game support...
notes.content:
It's time to admit your own shortcomings in the released projects and send them for well-deserved recycling.
Coming soon is #tacticalunderground arcade and SHOOT. KILL. REPEAT. they will be withdrawn from sale on Steam.
In the future, they will return in a new form, with a new engine and a new edition.
Those who bought these games on these platforms will receive an update to the new version.
And now I'm focused on developing a collection of mini-games, but I'll tell you about it later...

notes.title: It's time to start shooting!
notes.content:
SHOOT. KILL. REPEAT. IS OUT!
Challenge yourself in a hardcore shooter with a simulation of full-fledged work with weapons and your equipment. Search, shoot, survive, repeat!
Play co-op mode with your friends online using Steam Remote Play Together!
The game is distributed as DLC to the Pavel Repin Collection.
A video dedicated to this game will be published in the coming days!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219260/SHOOT_KILL_REPEAT/

notes.title: Postponing the release date of SHOOT. KILL. REPEAT. !

notes.title: Waiting for the SHOOT. KILL. REPEAT.
notes.content:
SHOOT. KILL. REPEAT. - This is a future hardcore shooter with a top view. The main feature of this game is that all tasks, maps, loot are generated randomly. Each of your survival is unique! The game will feature advanced character control mechanics, similar to #tacticalunderground arcade. You will be able to shoot and look out from behind corners. In addition, you will need to manually reload your weapons, load cartridges into magazines, search for a walkie-talkie signal, and organize the placement of ammunition and things on your equipment. Each of these actions will be a mini-game. At the same time, when performing the previously listed actions, the game will not be paused, and you will be vulnerable to an external threat. Accordingly, before reloading a weapon, reloading a magazine, or performing any other action, you must find a safe shelter.
The game footage will be published soon, you can also subscribe to the Repin Develop page in VK: https://vk.com/repindevelop or Telegram: https://t.me/repindevelop
The game is planned to have a cooperative mode, but it will be absent on the release on February 20 and will appear a little later.
